web_events.answer: Based on the most recent information, the Federal Reserve is expected to keep its key interest rate steady for the rest of 2026, although there is a high likelihood of a hike this year. web_events.answer: China's latest Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data for July 2026 indicates a slight recovery in manufacturing activity. The chemical industry saw a 5.0% year-on-year increase in value added in the first half of 2026, with a small decline in June. The overall industrial sector experienced a 5.3% year-on-year growth in June, with the manufacturing industry growing by 6.0% and the production and supply of electricity, heat, gas, and water growing by 7.4%.
